global_maxconn.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections for the entire HAProxy process.

global_ssl_default_bind.description: Enable strict SSL defaults (TLSv1.2 minimum, no session tickets) for bind lines.

defaults_timeout_connect.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection attempt to a server.

defaults_timeout_client.description: Maximum inactivity time on the client side.

defaults_timeout_server.description: Maximum inactivity time on the server side.

defaults_retries.description: Number of retries when a connection to a server fails.

frontends.description: List of frontend definitions (HTTP entry points).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '*'). Set to '*' for all interfaces.

bind_port.description: Port to listen on (e.g., 80 for HTTP).

ssl_port.description: Port for HTTPS (if ssl_cert is defined).

ssl_cert.description: Path to combined cert+key PEM file (e.g., '/etc/haproxy/certs/site.pem'). Leave empty to disable HTTPS.

mode.description: Override default mode for this frontend: 'http', 'tcp', or 'health'.

acl_rules.description: List of ACL rules to define conditions for routing.

use_backend_rules.description: List of routing rules to send traffic to specific backends based on ACLs.

backend_name.description: Name of the backend to route matching traffic to.

default_backend.description: Backend to use if no ACL rules match (fallback). Required if use_backend_rules is empty.

stats_uri.description: URI path for the per-frontend stats endpoint.

name.description: Unique backend name (must match referenced backend names in frontends).

mode.description: Proxy mode for this backend: 'http' or 'tcp'.

health_check_path.description: Path used for HTTP health checks (e.g., '/healthz'). Leave empty to disable HTTP checks.

health_check_port.description: Port for TCP-level health checks (fallback if health_check_path is empty).

server_options.description: Enable 'option http-server-close' for better connection handling.

name.description: Server identifier (must be unique within the backend).

address.description: IP address or hostname of the server.

check.description: Enable health checks for this server.

maxconn.description: Maximum concurrent connections to this server (optional).

weight.description: Server weight for weighted load balancing (1–256).

backup.description: Mark as backup server (only used if all primary servers are down).

stats_frontend_enable.description: Enable a dedicated stats listener for HAProxy’s global statistics UI.

stats_frontend_uri.description: URI path for the stats UI (e.g., '/stats', '/haproxy-stats').

stats_frontend_auth_user.description: Username for stats authentication (leave blank to disable auth).

stats_frontend_auth_pass.description: Password for stats authentication (ignored if auth_user is blank).
